With a whopping ten pieces, including accessories, Gladiator Hulk is probably the most complex BAF that I've put together in a long time.
The components include the gladiator helmet, shoulder armor, arm plates, belt with skirt, sandals, and two weapons (hammer and axe).
Yes, he's the same size as the Age of Ultron Hulk and he wasn't in scale either.
The review was published December 11, 2017, indicating this wave was current at that time.
Gone is the off grey chest armor and brown pants, replaced with sleeker, cooler looking black for both parts of the costume.

The helmet has a great Spartan flair with big top feather. The chest plate is massive and the arms are huge with vein detailing and wraps and gauntlets.
The head in particular looks great since it furthers the illusion of the helmeted portrait with darker paint around the eyes with an almost possessed glare in the eyes.
His torso joint is somewhat limited, which coupled with his restricting neck joint, doesn't allow for the most dynamic poses.
He comes with a massive axe and sword...The knife in the sheath is removable as well as the helmet...Ares comes with the mace and left arm for the BAF Gladiator Hulk.
For $20 you're getting a lot here.
November 4, 2017
